bio: Looking for a reason to stay off this app. Fueled entirely by iced coffee and bad decisions.

choices.choiceText: Hey Evelyn! Loved your music taste in your bio.
You look like you're about to fight someone in your photos.
Hey there, hope you're having a good day!

nodes.partnerMessage: Wait, someone actually read my bio instead of just swiping? I'm shocked.

choices.choiceText: Of course I did. What bands have you been looping lately?
I make video games and play acoustic guitar, so good music catches my eye.

nodes.partnerMessage: Excuse me? You don't know me, {PlayerName}. Don't start testing my patience on message one.

choices.choiceText: Just saying you've got strong energy haha.

nodes.partnerMessage: Ugh, generic greeting alert. You guys really use the same script on everyone, huh?

choices.choiceText: Ouch, tough crowd. Let me restart with something real.
Just trying to be polite, geez.

nodes.partnerMessage: Mostly dark indie and Midwest emo when I'm stressed. Which is basically 24/7.

choices.choiceText: Solid taste. Sounds like you need an iced coffee to destress.

nodes.partnerMessage: Fine, whatever. Truce. Just sick of dry small talk. What do you actually do with your life, {PlayerName}?

choices.choiceText: I make video games and play guitar.
Work, sleep, and try not to get yelled at by matches.

nodes.partnerMessage: Okay, that's actually pretty cool. Maybe you're not totally hopeless after all.

choices.choiceText: Told you. Let me get you an iced coffee sometime.
High praise coming from you haha.

nodes.partnerMessage: Polite is boring. Have fun staying single, {PlayerName}.
Look {PlayerName}, I hate this dating app. Add my handle on OnlyYaps before I delete this account. Don't make me regret it.
